--so far we have used openrowset to access the external data 
--but we are not creating any physical table or entity
--so if you want to access any particular external data again and again or from multiple locations then you have to use the openrowset function again and again
--it's always better to have a external table if we have any such use case


--EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT

--DROP EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT PARQUET_FORMAT;

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT CSV_FORMAT
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS
    (
        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
        STRING_DELIMITER = '"',
        FIRST_ROW = 2
    )
);


CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT PARQUET_FORMAT
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
);
